# `WorldApi::get_cell_structures`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns all placed structures occupying one cell.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_cell_structures (& self , cell : UVec2) -> Result < Vec < StructureInfo > , WorldApiError >
```

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/worldapi-get-cell-structures.md`](../../examples/methods/worldapi-get-cell-structures.md)_

```rust
let structures = world.get_cell_structures(UVec2::new(24, 18))?;
for structure in &structures {
```
